gamerule.doPhantomCreeperSpawning.descri: Whether phantom creepers spawn naturally above players.
gamerule.doPhantomCreeperDaytimeSpawning: Spawn Phantom Creepers during the day
Also spawn during the day. While enabled, phantom creepers don't burn in sunlight.
When a player can't see the sky (inside a building or cave), spawn them right inside the same space instead of skipping that player.
gamerule.doPhantomCreeperOverworldSpawni: Spawn Phantom Creepers in the Overworld
Whether phantom creepers spawn in the Overworld.
gamerule.doPhantomCreeperNetherSpawning: Spawn Phantom Creepers in the Nether
Whether phantom creepers spawn in the Nether. There is no sky there, so they spawn 6-14 blocks above the player where the player can see them, at any time of day.
gamerule.doPhantomCreeperEndSpawning: Spawn Phantom Creepers in the End
gamerule.doPhantomCreeperEndSpawning.des: Whether phantom creepers spawn in the End. Like the Nether, they spawn 6-14 blocks above the player at any time.
gamerule.phantomCreeperSpawnCount.descri: How many spawn near each player every time spawning happens (15-25 blocks above, or in the same room when indoors).
